resources.string: Optional, Android 16+. Phone taps trigger up to five seconds of location acquisition; physical-card taps alone cannot be detected. Requires notification access, precise and background location. Recognized payment notifications exclude nearby tap candidates. Candidates are private, used for at most two hours and cleared on the next access after expiry or when disabled. Ambiguous origins stay unconfirmed. No card content or wallet role is accessed.
